biothings.name: esophageal tuberculosis
biothings.definition: A tuberculosis that involves the esophagus. [MONDO:patterns/location]
biothings.synonyms: esophagus tuberculosis, oesophagus tuberculosis, tuberculosis of oesophagus

biothings.name: intestinal tuberculosis
biothings.definition: A tuberculosis that involves the intestine. [MONDO:patterns/location]

biothings.name: miliary tuberculosis
biothings.definition: I would say the hematogenous widespread dissemination of tuberculosis in the body. The term derives from the chest X-ray image of the tiny (1-5 mm) tuberculosis lesions which are seen through out the lung parenchyma. [NCIT:P378]
biothings.synonyms: acute miliary tuberculosis, disseminated tuberculosis, generalised tuberculosis, generalized tuberculosis

biothings.name: ureter tuberculosis
biothings.definition: A tuberculosis that involves the ureter. [MONDO:patterns/location]
